summary: Sets out requirements for an Internet audio codec, covering quality, sampling rate, bit rate, and robustness to packet loss, as well as other useful properties. It is informational and fed into later codec work.

eli5.summary: Before inventing a new way to squeeze sound for the internet, you list what it should do well. This is that list: good sound, small size, and still works when pieces get lost.

questions: requirements for a wideband audio codec
